title: Desktop JS path never navigates to the review screen after the final answer, unlike the no-JS POST path
detail: On desktop (>=1024px) the enhancement saves every answer in place but never navigates; the review screen (the only submit entry) renders only at the bare URL with no ?q=. The no-JS POST 303s there automatically; desktop JS users must reload manually.
recommended_fix: After the final question's PUT succeeds, assign to the bare URL on any viewport (the GET truthfully renders review or next-unanswered), or return an all-answered flag in the PUT response and navigate on it.

title: shouldStep seam is a tautological identity; the real mobile gate (matchMedia + MOBILE_QUERY) is untested
detail: shouldStep only double-negates its argument; the real gate (matchMedia + MOBILE_QUERY) lives untested inside initBrowser. The exported seam's tests assert an identity, guarding nothing, so the seam is abstraction without coverage.
recommended_fix: Test the real gate instead: extract a pure function that takes matchMedia's matches result (or assert the MOBILE_QUERY constant), or inline shouldStep and drop its tests.

title: _focus_seconds is documented as visibility-gated but implemented as raw wall-clock since page init
detail: The comment promises visibility-gated seconds; the code counts hidden-tab time too, inflating the rc3-4 form_session signal for tab-switchers. Benign direction, but the documented contract rc3-4 will threshold on is wrong.
recommended_fix: Track visibility (pause the accumulator on visibilitychange) to match the comment, or reword it to 'seconds since page init' so rc3-4 sets thresholds against true semantics.
